verdict.rationale: Canny publishes a first-party 'Canny API Reference' at developers.canny.io/api-reference, and its developer docs expose an llms.txt, so a documented public API exists. The pack gives only the page title, though: no endpoints, operations, or auth model are shown, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of the API's endpoint coverage and operations, authentication details, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
